nodes.question: 新能源需求增长是否真实，并且能流向可投资的产品节点？
nodes.conclusion: 需求真实，但最可投资的节点不是所有新能源产能，而是电网、电力电子、储能和少数受保护制造环节。

nodes.question: 电力需求、可再生装机与并网需求
nodes.conclusion: 发电侧增长很强，但约束点正在从发电设备转移到电网、储能和灵活性。

nodes.question: 电力需求增长是否足以支撑新能源产业链？
nodes.conclusion: Q1 is supported; the report should look for bottlenecks rather than broad renewables beta.
nodes.decision_use: 判断总需求是否足够大，避免在需求不足行业里找瓶颈。
nodes.materiality: 判断总需求是否足够大，避免在需求不足行业里找瓶颈。
nodes.support_evidence: Electricity 2026 and Renewables 2025 show strong electricity and low-emissions generation growth.
nodes.refute_evidence: Electricity demand slows, AI/data-center demand disappoints, or fossil generation absorbs incremental load.
nodes.target_implications: 提高电网、储能和低碳发电相关 future_space。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Electricity demand slows, AI/data-center demand disappoints, or fossil generation absorbs incremental load.
nodes.fact: IEA expects global electricity demand to grow strongly to 2030; low-emissions sources are expected to rise to 50% of generation by 2030.
nodes.inference: Demand growth is real, but the investment question is where that demand hits a scarce node.
nodes.judgment: Q1 is supported; the report should look for bottlenecks rather than broad renewables beta.
nodes.gap: Need regional load growth and tariff data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if grid load growth, data-center demand or policy support weakens.

nodes.question: 可再生装机增长是否已经遇到并网和灵活性约束？
nodes.conclusion: The report should prioritize grid/flexibility bottlenecks over commodity PV capacity.
nodes.decision_use: 决定瓶颈是否从发电设备转向电网/储能。
nodes.materiality: 决定瓶颈是否从发电设备转向电网/储能。
nodes.support_evidence: IEA discusses curtailment, negative prices, grid constraints and BESS co-location.
nodes.refute_evidence: Grid constraints ease quickly or generation equipment remains the main bottleneck.
nodes.target_implications: 提升电网设备、储能和电力电子评分；压低纯组件 beta。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Grid constraints ease quickly or generation equipment remains the main bottleneck.
nodes.fact: IEA notes curtailment and negative price events in more markets and highlights grids, storage and flexibility.
nodes.inference: When renewable generation grows faster than grids and flexible load, the scarcity shifts toward interconnection and storage.
nodes.judgment: The report should prioritize grid/flexibility bottlenecks over commodity PV capacity.
nodes.gap: Need country-level queue, curtailment and connection-time datasets.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if grid investment catches up or curtailment falls without new equipment demand.

nodes.question: 电动车、储能与电池需求
nodes.conclusion: EV 与储能仍是长期需求，但电池制造供给充足，稀缺性需要下沉到客户、技术、成本和系统集成。

nodes.question: EV 增长是否还能支撑电池和整车利润？
nodes.conclusion: EV/battery exposure should not automatically receive high action_state.
nodes.decision_use: 区分销量增长和利润增长。
nodes.materiality: 区分销量增长和利润增长。
nodes.support_evidence: IEA sees China as central to EV sales and battery cell production; BYD scale is large but profit fell.
nodes.refute_evidence: EV sales grow but competition erodes margin and returns.
nodes.target_implications: CATL/BYD 进入目标池，但评分必须受价格战约束。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: EV sales grow but competition erodes margin and returns.
nodes.fact: IEA says China remains the key EV market through 2030; BYD sold 4.6M NEVs in 2025, but net profit fell amid price-war pressure.
nodes.inference: EV volume demand is real, yet the value capture is contested by price competition.
nodes.judgment: EV/battery exposure should not automatically receive high action_state.
nodes.gap: Need current battery ASP, OEM margin and export profitability.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if EV volumes require deeper discounts or policy support weakens.

nodes.question: 储能需求是否比电池制造更具投资稀缺性？
nodes.conclusion: Prioritize ESS leaders with integration, control software, bankability and channel scale.
nodes.decision_use: 判断储能机会在 cell、PCS、系统集成还是项目运营。
nodes.materiality: 判断储能机会在 cell、PCS、系统集成还是项目运营。
nodes.support_evidence: IEA highlights batteries as flexibility resources; CATL and Sungrow show ESS scale.
nodes.refute_evidence: Manufacturing capacity grows faster than demand, compressing margins.
nodes.target_implications: 提高储能系统、电力电子和头部电芯的 future_space，但不提高所有电池产能。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Manufacturing capacity grows faster than demand, compressing margins.
nodes.fact: IEA says batteries are key for power-system flexibility; CATL led ESS battery shipments and Sungrow's ESS became a major revenue pillar.
nodes.inference: Storage demand is structurally supported by grid constraints, but manufacturing oversupply can move value away from cells to systems and controls.
nodes.judgment: Prioritize ESS leaders with integration, control software, bankability and channel scale.
nodes.gap: Need storage backlog, gross margin and warranty-loss data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if ESS price declines outpace cost reduction.

nodes.question: 价值捕获瓶颈在哪里，哪些节点有稀缺性和财务转化？
nodes.conclusion: 电网设备和电力电子的瓶颈强于普通光伏组件与电池制造；储能需求强，但集成商执行与价格风险高。

nodes.question: 电网与电力电子瓶颈
nodes.conclusion: 电气化、数据中心和新能源并网共同推高电网设备、电力转换和控制系统的价值捕获。

nodes.question: 电网设备是否是当前最强瓶颈？
nodes.conclusion: GEV is one of the clearest scarcity-to-backlog targets, but valuation must be checked.
nodes.decision_use: 决定 GEV 是否是核心观察标的。
nodes.materiality: 决定 GEV 是否是核心观察标的。
nodes.support_evidence: GE Vernova backlog and orders reflect grid/power equipment demand.
nodes.refute_evidence: Backlog is cyclical, execution risk rises, or valuation fully prices backlog.
nodes.target_implications: GEV 获得最高瓶颈分之一。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Backlog is cyclical, execution risk rises, or valuation fully prices backlog.
nodes.fact: GE Vernova reported backlog growth to $163B and raised guidance; Prolec GE adds transformer/grid equipment exposure.
nodes.inference: Grid equipment connects electricity demand, renewable integration and data-center power needs into a scarce equipment node.
nodes.judgment: GEV is one of the clearest scarcity-to-backlog targets, but valuation must be checked.
nodes.gap: Need segment margin and order-quality decomposition.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if backlog converts poorly to margin or orders slow.

nodes.question: 电力电子/逆变器是否比普通组件更能捕获价值？
nodes.conclusion: Sungrow's ESS/inverter mix is more aligned with grid-scale demand; Enphase is watch-only until residential demand stabilizes.
nodes.decision_use: 判断 Sungrow、Enphase 的节点质量。
nodes.materiality: 判断 Sungrow、Enphase 的节点质量。
nodes.support_evidence: Sungrow ESS/inverter revenue; Enphase microinverter margin but weak US demand.
nodes.refute_evidence: Inverter becomes commoditized or residential solar demand stays weak.
nodes.target_implications: Sungrow 优先级高于 Enphase；Enphase 需要需求拐点。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Inverter becomes commoditized or residential solar demand stays weak.
nodes.fact: Sungrow FY2025 revenue grew with ESS as key pillar; Enphase Q1 revenue fell, though non-GAAP gross margin remained 43.9%.
nodes.inference: Power electronics is a real control point, but geographic/customer mix matters.
nodes.judgment: Sungrow's ESS/inverter mix is more aligned with grid-scale demand; Enphase is watch-only until residential demand stabilizes.
nodes.gap: Need product margin by inverter/ESS and backlog.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if margins fall or US residential demand remains weak.

nodes.question: 制造与系统集成价值捕获
nodes.conclusion: 太阳能制造、电池、储能系统和整车需要分开看：规模强不等于定价权强。

nodes.question: 光伏制造中还有没有可防守的稀缺节点？
nodes.conclusion: FSLR has a stronger scarcity profile than generic PV manufacturers.
nodes.decision_use: 区分 First Solar 和普通组件产能。
nodes.materiality: 区分 First Solar 和普通组件产能。
nodes.support_evidence: First Solar has backlog and policy/manufacturing differentiation; LONGi shows broader PV pressure.
nodes.refute_evidence: Trade/policy edge fades or CdTe loses cost advantage.
nodes.target_implications: FSLR 可进入高优先级；普通组件龙头不因规模自动高分。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Trade/policy edge fades or CdTe loses cost advantage.
nodes.fact: First Solar had 47.9 GW contracted backlog and Q1 sales growth; LONGi Q1 revenue was pressured while pursuing solar-storage integration.
nodes.inference: PV demand is strong, but defensible value capture sits in protected/differentiated manufacturing rather than generic module capacity.
nodes.judgment: FSLR has a stronger scarcity profile than generic PV manufacturers.
nodes.gap: Need ASP, backlog price, policy durability and capacity ramp.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if backlog pricing weakens or trade/45X support changes.

nodes.question: 电池与整车龙头是否有不可替代性？
nodes.conclusion: CATL remains a core battery/ESS target; BYD is watch-only until margin and overseas mix improve.
nodes.decision_use: 判断 CATL/BYD 的稀缺性是否足够高。
nodes.materiality: 判断 CATL/BYD 的稀缺性是否足够高。
nodes.support_evidence: CATL has global ESS share; BYD has scale and integration.
nodes.refute_evidence: Price war and capacity expansion destroy excess return.
nodes.target_implications: CATL 高于 BYD；BYD 因整车价格战降级为观察。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Price war and capacity expansion destroy excess return.
nodes.fact: CATL led ESS battery shipments and has technology roadmap; BYD sold 4.6M NEVs but profit declined.
nodes.inference: CATL's bankability and technology mix are more scarce than generic battery capacity; BYD's integrated model is powerful but exposed to auto price war.
nodes.judgment: CATL remains a core battery/ESS target; BYD is watch-only until margin and overseas mix improve.
nodes.gap: Need battery ASP, overseas margin and ESS gross margin.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if battery ASP decline outpaces cost improvement.

nodes.question: 哪些反证会压低胜率、赔率或行动状态？
nodes.conclusion: 最大反证来自产能过剩、政策退坡、并网瓶颈、利率/融资、价格战和估值已经兑现。

nodes.question: 产能过剩、价格战与政策风险
nodes.conclusion: 普通组件、电池和车企的供给反应快，政策与贸易变化会迅速改变利润池。

nodes.question: 光伏和电池产能过剩会不会吞噬需求红利？
nodes.conclusion: Overcapacity is the main reason not to turn broad新能源 beta into high scores.
nodes.decision_use: 给普通制造环节设置评分上限。
nodes.materiality: 给普通制造环节设置评分上限。
nodes.support_evidence: IEA battery capacity could nearly quadruple by 2030 if announcements materialize; PV manufacturing pressure is visible.
nodes.refute_evidence: Demand grows faster than supply and margins recover.
nodes.target_implications: 普通组件、电芯和低差异化制造被封顶。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Demand grows faster than supply and margins recover.
nodes.fact: IEA notes battery manufacturing announcements could nearly quadruple capacity by 2030; LONGi and BYD disclosures show margin pressure in competitive areas.
nodes.inference: Strong end-demand can coexist with weak returns when supply expands faster.
nodes.judgment: Overcapacity is the main reason not to turn broad新能源 beta into high scores.
nodes.gap: Need supply-demand balance by region and technology.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if ASP and margins continue falling.

nodes.question: 政策、贸易和利率是否会改变利润池？
nodes.conclusion: Policy-dependent targets need hard kill tests.
nodes.decision_use: 识别政策依赖和融资风险。
nodes.materiality: 识别政策依赖和融资风险。
nodes.support_evidence: US tax credits, tariffs, trade protection and project finance matter for FSLR/ENPH/storage.
nodes.refute_evidence: Policy support stays stable and financing conditions improve.
nodes.target_implications: 提高有政策保护但不完全依赖政策的标的；压低 residential solar 与项目融资敏感资产。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Policy support stays stable and financing conditions improve.
nodes.fact: First Solar and Enphase disclosures reference policy/tax-credit context; storage and solar projects are sensitive to financing and trade rules.
nodes.inference: Policy can create moat, but it can also disappear or move demand between regions.
nodes.judgment: Policy-dependent targets need hard kill tests.
nodes.gap: Need updated tariff, tax-credit and interest-rate data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if subsidies/tariffs reverse or tax equity availability tightens.

nodes.question: 市场定价、融资与执行风险
nodes.conclusion: 强需求若已被高估值提前反映，或项目融资/交付失败，仍不构成好机会。

nodes.question: 当前市场定价是否已经充分反映新能源瓶颈？
nodes.conclusion: A target can be high-quality and still only watch_only if valuation is stretched or unverified.
nodes.decision_use: 决定 action_state 是否能提高。
nodes.materiality: 决定 action_state 是否能提高。
nodes.support_evidence: Strong narratives may already be priced; complete valuation bridge needs market data.
nodes.refute_evidence: Valuation still implies conservative growth and margins.
nodes.target_implications: GEV/FSLR 的基本面强，但估值需保守；本报告不强行给所有强基本面高行动状态。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Valuation still implies conservative growth and margins.
nodes.fact: The source set proves demand/backlog but does not by itself prove underpricing for every target.
nodes.inference: Valuation odds must be capped where market-implied growth/margin is not verified.
nodes.judgment: A target can be high-quality and still only watch_only if valuation is stretched or unverified.
nodes.gap: Need current market cap, EV, consensus EBITDA/FCF and peer ranges.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if multiples imply peak margin or flawless execution.

nodes.question: 项目执行、质保和客户集中是否会破坏现金流？
nodes.conclusion: Execution risk keeps FLNC watch_only/no_action despite strong storage demand.
nodes.decision_use: 检查储能集成商与设备商的执行风险。
nodes.materiality: 检查储能集成商与设备商的执行风险。
nodes.support_evidence: Fluence and storage integrators face backlog-to-margin execution risk; grid equipment must convert backlog to profit.
nodes.refute_evidence: Backlog converts cleanly and warranty/commissioning losses remain controlled.
nodes.target_implications: 储能系统集成商分数低于设备龙头和电芯龙头。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Backlog converts cleanly and warranty/commissioning losses remain controlled.
nodes.fact: Fluence disclosures emphasize project cycle, customer, supplier and component risks; GEV/FSLR still need backlog-to-margin monitoring.
nodes.inference: Backlog is not cash flow until delivered at planned margin.
nodes.judgment: Execution risk keeps FLNC watch_only/no_action despite strong storage demand.
nodes.gap: Need gross margin, warranty, order conversion and cash conversion data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if backlog grows while margins or cash flow deteriorate.

nodes.question: 当前应如何形成新能源标的观察名单？
nodes.conclusion: 目标池应按需求流向、稀缺性、财务转化和市场定价排序；如果低估证据不足，则保持观察而非强行多头。

nodes.question: 目标池与排序
nodes.conclusion: 从经济价值捕获出发，保留全球和中国核心标的，不按美股便利性收缩。

nodes.question: 哪些证券是真正的价值捕获载体？
nodes.conclusion: The final ranking includes local targets even where valuation feeds need more work.
nodes.decision_use: 建立目标池，不按交易所便利性收缩。
nodes.materiality: 建立目标池，不按交易所便利性收缩。
nodes.support_evidence: Grid equipment, protected solar, battery/ESS leaders and selected power electronics are real value-capture vehicles.
nodes.refute_evidence: A target is only a broad sector proxy without scarce value capture.
nodes.target_implications: 保留 GEV、FSLR、CATL、Sungrow、BYD、ENPH、FLNC、LONGi 等观察池。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: A target is only a broad sector proxy without scarce value capture.
nodes.fact: The target universe spans US, China A/H and ADR/local listings; source quality differs by region.
nodes.inference: Economic exposure should determine inclusion, not data convenience.
nodes.judgment: The final ranking includes local targets even where valuation feeds need more work.
nodes.gap: Need same-currency valuation and liquidity data.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade when valuation and monitorability are complete.

nodes.question: 排序如何从分数而不是叙事产生？
nodes.conclusion: The list should be objective about no_action and watch_only states.
nodes.decision_use: 防止因为行业热度强行推荐。
nodes.materiality: 防止因为行业热度强行推荐。
nodes.support_evidence: Score combines chokepoint, future space, valuation, evidence, risk control, monitorability and payoff.
nodes.refute_evidence: Narrative appeal is high but market pricing or risk control is weak.
nodes.target_implications: 只有 GEV/FSLR/CATL/Sungrow 具备较高观察价值；部分标的保守处理。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: Narrative appeal is high but market pricing or risk control is weak.
nodes.fact: The scoring object separates scarcity and valuation; action_state defaults to no_action until evidence supports demand, scarcity and expected excess return.
nodes.inference: High-quality companies with incomplete valuation can remain watch_only.
nodes.judgment: The list should be objective about no_action and watch_only states.
nodes.gap: Need full valuation and kill-test feeds.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade only when missing valuation/risk-control data is resolved.

nodes.question: 验证周期与触发器
nodes.conclusion: live 模式不附后验 label；以三个月验证周期跟踪订单、利润、价格、政策和估值。

nodes.question: 哪些数据会升级观察强度？
nodes.conclusion: The review horizon is 2026-08-31.
nodes.decision_use: 定义 live 模式三个月验证数据。
nodes.materiality: 定义 live 模式三个月验证数据。
nodes.support_evidence: Orders, backlog conversion, margins, ASP and policy data can change scores.
nodes.refute_evidence: No data can change the thesis within review horizon.
nodes.target_implications: 给每个节点设置升级触发器。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.refuting_source_plan: No data can change the thesis within review horizon.
nodes.fact: Useful upgrade data are GEV order/margin conversion, FSLR backlog pricing, CATL/Sungrow ESS margin, BYD overseas margin and Enphase demand stabilization.
nodes.inference: These indicators map directly to score components.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade when order/margin/valuation data improves together.

nodes.question: 哪些数据会触发降级或 kill test？
nodes.conclusion: Any actionable observation should be cut if its core kill test is confirmed.
nodes.decision_use: 定义撤销高分的硬条件。
nodes.materiality: 定义撤销高分的硬条件。
nodes.support_evidence: Key downside tests: supply glut, policy reversal, project finance stress, margin compression and valuation overpricing.
nodes.target_implications: 所有高分标的都必须配 kill test。
nodes.minimum_evidence_gate: At least one current, source-linked fact plus one explicit refuting test before strengthening the parent node.
nodes.fact: The most important kill tests are falling margins despite demand growth, grid order slowdown, storage project losses, policy/tariff reversal and EV price-war intensification.
nodes.inference: These tests attack scarcity, financial conversion and valuation odds.
nodes.judgment: Any actionable observation should be cut if its core kill test is confirmed.
nodes.gap: Need project-level and segment-level margin data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade when official results confirm any kill test.
